# Langford | Ramos

> Langford | Ramos is a criminal defense firm in Salt Lake City, Utah representing people facing criminal investigations and charges in state and federal court. The firm handles serious criminal matters from investigation through trial.

## Attorneys

Michael J. Langford and Alexander E. Ramos are the partners. Both handle serious criminal matters in state and federal court and remain personally involved in the cases they take.

- [Attorneys](https://langfordramoslaw.com/attorneys/)

## Practice Areas

The firm focuses on three areas: federal criminal defense, Utah state criminal defense, and pre-charge investigations.

- [Practice](https://langfordramoslaw.com/practice/)

## Cases Handled

Murder, manslaughter, aggravated assault, robbery, burglary, kidnapping, rape, sexual assault, arson, domestic violence, stalking, DUI, drug possession, drug distribution, drug trafficking, firearms offenses, felon in possession, theft, fraud, identity theft, wire fraud, mail fraud, bank fraud, healthcare fraud, tax crimes, money laundering, conspiracy, racketeering, obstruction of justice, witness tampering, and cybercrime.
